boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Hendrix College
boards.description: Ten currently verifiable, under-21-safe food stops in Conway with late or round-the-clock service.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Prince Street
cards.subtitle: 2715 Prince Street, Conway
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when dining room service has ended; the official location page lists the drive-thru as open 24 hours every day.
cards.short_summary: A Prince Street drive-thru with round-the-clock listed availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the drive-thru at 2715 Prince Street as open 24 hours daily.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours as open 24 hours Sunday through Saturday; dine-in hours are more limited.

cards.title: Taco Bell on East Oak
cards.subtitle: 205 E Oak Street, Conway
cards.notes: Plan for drive-thru service after the dining room closes; the location’s official hours show the drive-thru open 24 hours daily.
cards.short_summary: An East Oak option whose listed drive-thru schedule runs around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the drive-thru at 205 E Oak Street as open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 205 E Oak Street, Conway
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours as 12:00 AM–12:00 AM every day; dine-in hours are separately limited.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Dave Ward Drive
cards.subtitle: 2195 Dave Ward Drive, Conway
cards.notes: Check the day before heading out: official drive-thru hours extend to 4 AM most nights and 5 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Dave Ward drive-thru with listed service into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru service until 4 AM Sunday–Thursday and 5 AM Friday–Saturday at this location.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 2195 Dave Ward Drive, Conway
cards.access_notes: Official drive-thru hours: until 4 AM Sunday–Thursday and 5 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Whataburger on East Oak
cards.subtitle: 813 E Oak Street, Conway
cards.notes: This location lists dine-in and drive-thru service 24 hours daily, giving a clearly documented all-night food option on East Oak.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour dine-in and drive-thru restaurant on East Oak.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger #1518 lists its dine-in and drive-thru service as 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists dine-in and drive-thru as 24 hours Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Denny’s on Crain Drive
cards.subtitle: 900 Crain Drive, Conway
cards.notes: Choose this diner when you need a sit-down option late; its official Conway page lists the restaurant as open 24 hours every day.
cards.short_summary: A Conway diner with officially listed 24-hour restaurant service.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s lists its 900 Crain Drive Conway restaurant as open 24 hours daily.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant hours as open 24 hours Sunday through Saturday.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Oak Street
cards.subtitle: 311 Oak Street, Conway
cards.notes: Use either the restaurant or drive-thru before midnight; the official location page lists both services until 12 AM every day.
cards.short_summary: An Oak Street restaurant and drive-thru open through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 7 AM–12 AM daily at 311 Oak Street.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours as 7 AM–12 AM Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Highway 64 West
cards.subtitle: 1200 Highway 64 West, Conway
cards.notes: Confirm your route, then use the listed restaurant or drive-thru service through midnight; both have the same daily posted closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Highway 64 West option with restaurant and drive-thru hours through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 7 AM–12 AM daily at 1200 Highway 64 West.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours as 7 AM–12 AM Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Dave Ward Drive
cards.subtitle: 3750 Dave Ward Drive, Conway
cards.notes: For a midnight closing-time option on Dave Ward, use the restaurant or drive-thru; the location page posts both services until 12 AM daily.
cards.short_summary: A Dave Ward restaurant and drive-thru with midnight listed closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 7 AM–12 AM daily at 3750 Dave Ward Drive.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours as 7 AM–12 AM Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Domino’s on East German Lane
cards.subtitle: 1075 East German Lane, Conway
cards.notes: Use the store’s current-hours display before placing a carryout or delivery order; its official location page currently shows service until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A pizza carryout and delivery location currently listed through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official location page for 1075 East German Lane currently lists the store open until 12 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official location page currently displays “Today Until 12:00 AM”; it advises customers to check its Hours section for up-to-date store hours.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on East Oak
cards.subtitle: 1825 E Oak Street, Conway
cards.notes: Order carryout or delivery from this East Oak location; the official page posts midnight closing Sunday through Thursday and 1 AM Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: An East Oak pizza stop with official late-week hours extending to 1 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 1 AM Friday–Saturday at 1825 E Oak Street.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut — 1825 E Oak Street, Conway
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant-hours table lists 9 AM–12 AM Sunday–Thursday and 9 AM–1 AM Friday–Saturday.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Hendrix College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A conservative, under-21-safe sequence of orientation, campus, arts, and community stops for a first Hendrix weekend.

cards.title: Start at the SLTC
cards.subtitle: Orientation check-in and campus services
cards.notes: After settling in, use the Student Life and Technology Center as your first practical stop for orientation materials and campus-service questions.
cards.short_summary: A useful first stop for orientation logistics.
cards.evidence_claim: Hendrix directs newly moved-in students to the Student Life and Technology Center for orientation registration and campus resources.
cards.access_notes: Orientation registration is tied to Hendrix move-in programming; consult the current orientation schedule for access.

cards.title: Meet your people at the Brick Pit
cards.subtitle: Central campus gathering space
cards.notes: Walk to the Brick Pit with your orientation group, then use the open area as a simple landmark for reconnecting between scheduled activities.
cards.short_summary: A named campus gathering point for making connections.
cards.evidence_claim: Hendrix identifies the Brick Pit as an area between residence halls and academic buildings and the site of many events.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; use it for scheduled events or normal pedestrian access.

cards.title: Have a meal in the SLTC cafeteria
cards.subtitle: Second floor of the Student Life and Technology Center
cards.notes: Use a meal break to learn the SLTC layout and compare notes with your new group before continuing around the central campus.
cards.short_summary: A meal stop inside the main student-services building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hendrix campus map lists the Cafeteria on the second floor of the Student Life and Technology Center.
cards.source_title: Hendrix College Campus Map and Guide
cards.access_notes: Dining access and meal-plan terms may apply; verify current dining arrangements with Hendrix.

cards.title: Get oriented at Bailey Library
cards.subtitle: Library, research support, and academic resources
cards.notes: Make a daytime pass through Bailey Library so you can identify research help, collections, and study resources before classes begin.
cards.short_summary: A first-weekend orientation stop for academic support.
cards.evidence_claim: Bailey Library offers collections, research support, interlibrary loan, peer-assisted learning, and writing-center services.
cards.access_notes: Library services and building access can vary; check Bailey Library's current hours before visiting.

cards.title: See what is on view at Windgate
cards.subtitle: Miller Creative Quad
cards.notes: Take a quiet loop through the galleries, read the exhibition information, and note future programs that fit your first-semester calendar.
cards.short_summary: A campus art stop with exhibitions and student-facing programs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Windgate Museum of Art is on the Hendrix campus, presents exhibitions and programs, and is free and open to all.
cards.source_title: Windgate Museum of Art | Hendrix College
cards.access_notes: Free public access is stated by Hendrix; confirm current gallery hours or event schedules before going.

cards.title: Take a campus pause at Pecan Court
cards.subtitle: Named outdoor space beside Butler Plaza
cards.notes: Use this named outdoor stop to reset after indoor orientation sessions, then continue your walk using the campus map rather than cutting through residence areas.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed outdoor waypoint on the Hendrix campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hendrix campus map lists Butler Plaza and Pecan Court as a named campus destination.
cards.source_title: Hendrix College Campus Map and Guide
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus area; follow posted access guidance and scheduled-event instructions.

cards.title: Find the Murphy House
cards.subtitle: Literature and language programs
cards.notes: Locate the Murphy House during daylight, then watch Hendrix event listings for a reading, workshop, or film program you can attend later.
cards.short_summary: A literary-programming landmark with student study space.
cards.evidence_claim: Hendrix describes the Bertie Wilson Murphy Building as home to literature and language programs, readings, workshops, and a first-floor library.
cards.access_notes: Programs are event-dependent; confirm whether a reading, workshop, or screening is open before attending.

cards.title: Locate the Wellness and Athletics Center
cards.subtitle: Campus recreation and event facilities
cards.notes: Find the Wellness and Athletics Center before you need it, and check Hendrix programming for a scheduled recreation, game, or campus event.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed athletics and recreation destination.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hendrix campus map lists the Wellness and Athletics Center, Grove Gymnasium, and Aquatics Center.
cards.source_title: Hendrix College Campus Map and Guide
cards.access_notes: Facility use may require student eligibility or scheduled access; check current recreation and event guidance.

cards.title: Check in with KHDX 93.1
cards.subtitle: Hendrix's student-run radio station
cards.notes: Listen for campus programming or follow KHDX updates to spot future all-ages concerts and student activities without relying on a one-time event.
cards.short_summary: A student-run radio connection to campus programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Hendrix identifies KHDX 93.1 as its on-campus radio station run by Hendrix students.
cards.access_notes: Programming and event access vary; use official KHDX and Hendrix announcements for current details.

cards.title: Learn the Shirttails tradition
cards.subtitle: First-year fall-semester tradition at the Brick Pit
cards.notes: Ask your orientation leader how your residence hall participates, then attend or take part only through the official first-year schedule and guidance.
cards.short_summary: A documented Hendrix first-year dance tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Hendrix documents Shirttails as a tradition for new students involving dancing in the Brick Pit at the start of the fall semester.
cards.access_notes: This is a fall-semester first-year tradition; follow current official orientation and residence-life instructions.
